I have listed the refunds. Now I need to compare the reported refunds with the requested refunds. The reported refunds are: [{'order_id': 121, 'amount_cents': 3797}, {'order_id': 122, 'amount_cents': 5470}, {'order_id': 124, 'amount_cents': 1085}].
